response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_of_averages FROM event_averages) SELECT ea.event_name, ea.avg_amount, ea.avg_amount - oa.mean_of_averages as above_average, ea.avg_amount / oa.mean_of_averages as ratio_to_mean FROM event_averages ea CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.mean_of_averages ORDER BY ea.event_name

assumptions.assumption: "Average budgeted amount" refers to the `amount` column in the budget table; NULL amounts are excluded from the average (standard SQL AVG behavior)
"Above the average" means strictly greater than (>), not greater than or equal to
"Budget lines matched to their events" requires budget.link_to_event to reference a valid event.event_id (INNER JOIN excludes unmatched budget records)
